general_notes: Better light direction must retain readable faces, figures and equipment.
Do not equate a painted surface with extreme darkening or crisp surface detail.
A magical scene needs an internally plausible relationship among action, object and setting.
Fresh compositions will test the notes; the eight-image edit experiment is not a universal recipe.
